name: graph-rag-agent
description: Agentic Graph-RAG support agent backed by Neo4j + LangGraph + vLLM. Answers support queries using semantic, BM25, and graph-based retrieval with CRAG quality gating and a ReAct reasoning loop.

skills.name: Graph-RAG Knowledge Search
skills.description: Answers support queries using a retrieval-augmented generation pipeline with semantic (dense), BM25 (sparse), and graph-based (PPR) retrieval, RRF fusion, vLLM cross-encoder reranking, CRAG quality gating, and a ReAct reasoning loop. Returns a cited answer with confidence score. When the query cannot be answered due to missing context or out-of-domain intent, the agent defers the query: it sets task state to TASK_STATE_INPUT_REQUIRED and returns a structured deferral payload containing a ready-to-speak clarification_prompt, the specific information gaps, and a deferral_reason object. The caller must speak the clarification_prompt to the user and re-submit with the same context_id once additional information is available.
examples: How do I reset my password?
My login keeps failing after the recent update.
How do I delete a payment method and set the currency for a course?
